chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Glorious:
"And no soul knows what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul knows in which land it will die."
So he said: "From one step to another."

key_terms.إِلَى قَدَمٍ: to another step, expressing how close the unknown future may be
key_terms.بِأَيِّ أَرْضٍ: in which land, referring to the unknown place of death
key_terms.تَكْسِبُ: earns or acquires, referring to what one will gain in the near future
key_terms.تَمُوتُ: dies, indicating the moment and location of death known only to Allah
key_terms.غَدًا: tomorrow, indicating the immediate future unknown to human beings
key_terms.مِنْ قَدَمٍ: from one step, indicating nearness and immediacy
key_terms.نَفْسٌ: a human soul or person, whose future remains unknown to itself

ai.seo_question: What does the verse 'no soul knows what it will earn tomorrow' mean in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a concise commentary on the verse about the hidden nature of what a person will acquire and where death will occur. The Imam عليه السلام explains that the unknown future may be as near as the next step, emphasizing the immediacy of human uncertainty before Allah’s knowledge.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.380 - The Imam (as) said regarding the words of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Glorious:
"No soul knows what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul knows in which land it will die" (Surah Luqman 31:34).
Imam (as) said; "From one step to another."
